queries.title: Requests per five minutes
queries.query: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(bucket) AS time, sum(requests) AS requests FROM click_play_boom_demo.request_rollup_5m WHERE bucket >= now() - INTERVAL {seconds:UInt32} SECOND GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

queries.title: Traffic by service
queries.query: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(bucket) AS time, service, sum(requests) AS requests FROM click_play_boom_demo.request_rollup_5m WHERE bucket >= now() - INTERVAL {seconds:UInt32} SECOND GROUP BY bucket, service ORDER BY bucket, service

queries.title: Errors by service
queries.query: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(bucket) AS time, service, sum(errors) AS errors FROM click_play_boom_demo.request_rollup_5m WHERE bucket >= now() - INTERVAL {seconds:UInt32} SECOND GROUP BY bucket, service ORDER BY bucket, service

queries.title: p95 latency by service
queries.query: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfFiveMinutes(observed_at)) AS time, service, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM click_play_boom_demo.requests WHERE observed_at >= now() - INTERVAL {seconds:UInt32} SECOND GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time, service
